title: Localizing predictive concepts encoded in neural representations via hierarchical testing
abstract: arXiv:2610.41046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding which regulatory sequence motifs a genomic deep learning model has learned, with statistical error guarantees, is essential for trusting its use in downstream tasks such as variant effect prediction. Existing approaches to identifying which units in a trained network encode human- understandable concepts fall into two groups. Exploratory methods rank and visualize units but offer no statistical guarantee that the selected units are associated with the prediction target across the population of inputs. Testing-based methods test only single units or one pre-defined set of them, and do not control the error across the many sets of units. We introduce CUTTIE (Cluster-tree Unit Top-down Testing of Independence with Error control), which clusters the units of each layer into a tree and tests the clusters top-down with conditional independence tests, localizing information about the target while controlling the family-wise error

translated_title: 通过分层检验定位神经表示中编码的预测性概念
translated_abstract: 理解基因组深度学习模型学习到了哪些调控序列基序（并具有统计误差保证），对于信任其在变异效应预测等下游任务中的应用至关重要。现有的识别训练网络中哪些单元编码人类可理解概念的方法分为两类。探索性方法对单元进行排序和可视化，但无法提供所选单元在输入总体上与预测目标相关联的统计保证；基于检验的方法仅检验单个单元或一个预先定义的单元集合，无法在众多单元集合之间控制误差。我们提出了CUTTIE（基于聚类树的单元自顶向下独立性检验与误差控制方法），该方法将每一层的单元聚类成一棵树，并通过条件独立性检验自顶向下地检验各聚类，在控制族错误率的同时定位关于预测目标的信息。
tldr: 提出CUTTIE方法，通过将神经网络各层单元聚类成树并自顶向下进行条件独立性检验，在控制族错误率的同时定位编码预测信息的单元。
en_tdlr: CUTTIE clusters units of each layer into a tree and tests them top-down with conditional independence tests, localizing units encoding predictive information while controlling the family-wise error rate.
